cohort: The study included 90 full-term newborns, equally divided into a culture-proven sepsis group and a control group.
finding: Serum IL-27 levels and MPV were significantly higher in the culture-proven sepsis group compared to controls, with IL-27 demonstrating superior diagnostic performance for LOS.
cross-section timing: At the time of suspected late-onset sepsis diagnosis in full-term neonates.
